definitions.meaning: a dimwit is a foolish person, an idiot
a fruit ... is a creamy dessert, so a sweet in the British sense of pudding

explanation.surface: A slow-witted person who is nonetheless kind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sweet' reads as a kind nature; it is the British word for dessert, here the fruit pudding.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses share one word: a silly person, and a pudding of puréed fruit folded into cream.

clue.text: Sort of artist in a way associated with flags

definitions.meaning: a street painter who chalks pictures on the walkway is named after that walkway
a footway laid with flagstones beside a road

explanation.surface: An artist somehow connected with banners or national flags.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flags' suggests banners; here they are flagstones, the slabs a British footway is laid with.
explanation.definitionFit: A British footway beside the road is paved with flagstones, and chalk artists work on it.

clue.text: US soldier hires out padded jackets

parts.note: GI is the usual name for an American private soldier
to let property is to rent it out

explanation.surface: An American serviceman renting out quilted body warmers.
explanation.definitionFit: Sleeveless padded jackets, body warmers, are known by this French-derived name.

clue.text: Irregular dates happily in the end becoming a regular one?

definitions.note: a regular partner, one you date; the question mark flags the play on regular

indicators.note: irregular means not in proper order, so the letters of dates are rearranged
points to the closing letter of happily

explanation.surface: Occasional dates eventually turn into a settled relationship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Irregular' rearranges DATES into STEAD; 'in the end' takes Y from happily.
explanation.definitionFit: A boyfriend or girlfriend you go out with regularly is called your steady, idiomatically.

clue.text: Greek island associated with a savoury snack

parts.note: Samos is an island in the eastern Aegean

explanation.surface: A Greek island known for a particular savoury bite.
explanation.definitionFit: A fried triangular pastry filled with spiced vegetables or meat, a South Asian snack.

indicators.note: only part of the word rehearsals is used, a run of its letters

explanation.surface: Rehearsals partly done for church organs, it seems.
explanation.definitionFit: The ears are the organs of hearing, a plain example of body organs.

clue.text: Due date that's not welcomed by caller?

definitions.meaning: the time by which a task must be finished
a telephone line with no tone is useless to someone ringing; the question mark marks the playful reading

explanation.surface: A cut-off date that nobody phoning in is happy about.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the second half as two words: a telephone line that is dead.
explanation.definitionFit: A cut-off time for completing work, the date by which something is due.

indicators.note: vandalised means damaged and broken up, so the letters of Somalian are rearranged

explanation.surface: A painting of a Somali person has been defaced.
explanation.definitionFit: Leonardo's famous painting in the Louvre is the best-known portrait in the world.

clue.text: Countless millions taken by milk producer rejected

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for million

indicators.note: rejected means sent back, so the farm word is read backwards

parts.note: a dairy produces milk and milk products

explanation.surface: Huge numbers of millions turned down by a milk company.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means too numerous to count, innumerable.

definitions.note: a noun here: a very close friend

parts.note: to alter is to change
eg, for example, is what 'say' means
O is the figure zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Change something private and keep quiet about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Intimate' looks like an adjective or verb; it is a noun, a close companion.
explanation.definitionFit: A second self, a trusted friend so close as to be almost one's other half.

indicators.note: heard means we want a word that sounds like the singing voice

parts.note: bass is the lowest male singing voice

explanation.surface: A singer's voice that sounds nasty or average when heard.
explanation.definitionFit: Base means low and ignoble in character, the same as mean or contemptible.

clue.text: Secure a time with TV presenter

parts.note: an anchor is the main presenter of a news programme

explanation.surface: Booking a slot with a television host.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship held fast by its anchor is moored, made secure.

clue.text: Pork cut in box served with processed brie

parts.note: to spar is to box, in training

indicators.note: processed means worked over, so the letters of brie are rearranged

explanation.surface: Pork in a box, served with processed cheese.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Box' looks like a container; it is the verb, to fight.
explanation.definitionFit: A cut of pork taken from the ribs with most of the meat trimmed off.

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the final letter of the summit word is dropped

parts.note: the peak is the highest point

explanation.surface: Your pulse nearly at its highest point.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pulse' looks like a heartbeat; it is the edible seed.
explanation.definitionFit: Pulses are edible seeds of legumes, like lentils and beans; this is one.

clue.text: One way of getting to the top in say, Washington

definitions.text: One way of getting to the top in say, Washington

parts.words: One way of getting to the top in say, Washington
parts.note: the clue sounds like rising in American politics, but means the American word for a lift going up a building

explanation.surface: A route to political power in the American capital.
explanation.walkthrough: Washington stands for the US generally, where a lift is called by another name.
explanation.definitionFit: Americans call a lift by this word, and it carries you up to a building's top floor.

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction to play quietly
an artisan is a skilled craftsman

explanation.surface: A soft-spoken craftsman turns out to be biased.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means biased in favour of one side, unfairly one-sided.

clue.text: Seasonal transport is murder, one's heard

indicators.note: says the word for murder is taken by its sound

parts.note: to slay is to kill, murder

explanation.surface: Christmas travel is murder, so people say.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Is murder' reads as a complaint about holiday travel.
explanation.definitionFit: Santa travels in a sledge drawn by reindeer, transport tied to Christmas.

parts.note: to utter is to say or state

explanation.surface: A lunatic who comes from a state in the north.
explanation.walkthrough: 'State' reads as a region; it is the verb, to say.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal British slang for a crazy person, a lunatic.

definitions.meaning: having paid back what is owed, square with someone

explanation.surface: Someone leaving the apartment.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both square with one another after repayment and level in surface.

definitions.meaning: an allotted place in a timetable
a narrow gap, as for a coin

explanation.surface: The planned hour for a grand opening.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both an allotted place in a schedule and a narrow aperture.

clue.text: Sergeant in mess put out of favour

indicators.note: a mess is a muddle, so the letters of Sergeant are jumbled; also the soldiers' dining room

explanation.surface: A sergeant falls out of favour in the military dining hall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mess' reads as the soldiers' canteen; it signals the jumble.
explanation.definitionFit: To alienate someone is to make them unfriendly, pushing them out of affection.

indicators.note: only part of the phrase prodigal son is used, a run of letters inside it

explanation.surface: Does the prodigal son miss home? Not completely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Misses' looks like a verb; it is the plural of Miss, young women.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal plural for girls or young women, who are addressed as Miss.

definitions.note: an adjective standing for a hot thing, the fiery pepper

indicators.note: sounding means the word for cold is taken by its sound

parts.note: chilly means cold

explanation.surface: Something sounds cold but is in fact hot, a paradox.
explanation.walkthrough: The contradiction is the joke: the cold word and the hot pepper sound alike.
explanation.definitionFit: The red pepper is famous for its fiery heat in cooking.

parts.note: re means on or concerning
noble means grand and imposing

explanation.surface: A splendid, impressive French city praised as good.
explanation.definitionFit: A city in the French Alps, capital of the Isère department.

clue.text: Cockney wife having lost capital is after credit support

indicators.note: is after means the shortened wife word comes behind the credit letters
losing its capital means dropping the opening letter of the wife word

parts.note: in Cockney slang a man's wife is his Dutch, short for duchess

explanation.surface: A Londoner's wife, having lost her money, chases a loan for support.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital' reads as money; it is the first letter. Cockney is the working-class East London dialect, where 'my old Dutch' means my wife.
explanation.definitionFit: A crutch is a prop to lean on, a physical or figurative support.
